mapper.insert: insert into salary(employee_id, salary_month, base_salary, bonus, deduction, real_salary) values (#{employeeId}, #{salaryMonth}, #{baseSalary}, #{bonus}, #{deduction}, #{realSalary})
mapper.select: select id, employee_id, salary_month, base_salary, bonus, deduction, real_salary from salary where employee_id = #{employeeId} order by salary_month desc
